data.description:
External PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/212 (author BenevolentFutures, 2026-05-26, single commit) adds Grok Build as a built-in agent type. Operator has CLEARED IT TO MERGE (2026-06-12) pending deep review + rebase.

State: CONFLICTING with main. The agent-registry surface moved since May: conversation store landed in 0.44 as the resume path; AgentRestartRegistry is deprecated (removal scheduled 0.46) and this PR patches it — the rebase must wire the new agent into the conversation-store era, not the deprecated rail. C11-131 (just merged, PR #239) also touched crash-resume in this area.

Files: CLI/c11.swift, AgentChip, AgentDetector, AgentRestartRegistry, AgentSkillsView, DefaultAgentConfig, SkillInstaller, SurfaceMetadataStore, c11Tests/DefaultAgentConfigTests, docs/adding-a-new-agent.md, skills/c11/SKILL.md + references/api.md.

Acceptance: deep code review recorded; rebased onto current main preserving contributor authorship in commit metadata; builds green; c11-logic suite green; skills updated AND scripts/sync-installed-skills.sh run if skills touched; localization pass for any user-facing strings; merged; PR comment crediting the contributor. Merge BEFORE C11-137 (#215) — oldest first; the second PR re-rebases over this one.

Related: C11-137 (PR #215, same files, same delegator thread).
data.title: Land PR #212: Grok Build as built-in agent type (rebase + deep review + merge)

data.body:
DEEP REVIEW — PR #212 (Grok Build), commit 75c0550 by Atin <atin@atin.me>, May 26.

VERDICT: high-quality, well-scoped, mechanical addition of 'grok' as a first-class agent type. 14 files, +132/-9. Even ships docs/adding-a-new-agent.md (a contributor checklist). Touches the exact canonical surfaces: AgentType enum, canonicalTerminalTypes, AgentChip icon+SF-symbol, AgentDetector classify, default-agent CLI valid list, SkillInstaller target, AgentSkillsView onboarding opt-ins, a factory test, and skill docs. All consistent with existing claude/codex/kimi/opencode rows.

RISKS / FINDINGS:
1. MODERNIZATION GAP (the real work): PR predates the conversation store (landed 0.44). It wires grok resume only into AgentRestartRegistry.phase1 — which is now the KILL-SWITCH FALLBACK (CMUX_DISABLE_CONVERSATION_STORE=1), removal scheduled 0.46. The LIVE resume path is ConversationStrategyRegistry.v1 (Sources/Conversation/Strategies/). All four existing agents have BOTH a registry row AND a conversation strategy. Grok is missing the strategy. PORT PLAN: KEEP the phase1 row (maintains fallback parity — removing it would make grok the only agent absent from the fallback), AND add Sources/Conversation/Strategies/Grok.swift + register in v1. Grok strategy = fresh-launch-only capture (no hook/scraper, like Kimi/Opencode); resume() types best-effort 'grok --always-approve --resume' for alive/suspended.
2. TEST UPDATE: ConversationStrategyTests.testV1RegistryContainsTheFourKinds asserts exactly the 4 kinds. Adding grok to v1 requires updating it (→5 kinds) + a grok resume test. Also add Grok.swift to pbxproj c11 target membership.
3. LOCALIZATION: one new user-facing string agentType.grok = 'Grok Build' via String(localized:). Needs the 6-locale pass.
4. SKILLS: touches skills/c11/SKILL.md + 3 references — run scripts/sync-installed-skills.sh after.
5. No security concerns: no executable wrapper, no shell injection surface (grok resume takes no id, so no untrusted interpolation). docs/adding-a-new-agent.md is purely additive.

Clean cherry-pick expected on the bulk; conflicts likely only in AgentRestartRegistry.swift (C11-131 touched this area) and skill docs.

VALIDATION (tagged build pr-212-land, socket /tmp/c11-debug-pr-212-land.sock):
- Full Debug app build (c11 scheme): ** BUILD SUCCEEDED ** — compiles the cherry-picked PR + my Grok.swift conversation strategy + registry/pbxproj/xcstrings changes.
- c11-logic suite (DefaultAgentConfigTests, 28 tests): ** TEST SUCCEEDED ** — includes the PR's testFactoryGrokCommandIncludesAlwaysApprove.
- Live CLI plumbing on tagged instance:
  * 'default-agent set grok' → OK grok; 'default-agent get' → OK grok.
  * 'default-agent set <bogus>' → valid-types list now reads: claude-code, codex, grok, kimi, opencode, custom.
  * 'set-agent --type grok --model grok-build' round-trips: terminal_type=grok (stored CANONICAL, not coerced to unknown — proves SurfaceMetadataStore.canonicalTerminalTypes change), model=grok-build.
- Sidebar chip: terminal_type=grok resolves through AgentChipResolver to the grok branch; no AgentIcons/grok asset shipped (by design, per PR doc) so it uses the bolt.fill SF-symbol fallback.
CAVEAT (explicit, no faked e2e): the grok CLI binary is not installed on this machine, so I did NOT launch a real Grok agent or exercise live session resume. Validated the c11-SIDE plumbing only: enum/config, canonical metadata, CLI accept-list, chip resolution, and that both resume rails (AgentRestartRegistry.phase1 fallback row + new ConversationStrategyRegistry.v1 GrokStrategy) compile and are wired.
NOTE: c11Tests host target has a PRE-EXISTING local-only compile error in SurfaceActivityTests.swift (XCTAssertEqual optional+accuracy; file byte-identical to origin/main, untouched by me) — ConversationStrategyTests deferred to CI per delegator brief.
OPERATOR CONFIRMATION (2026-06-12): Atin confirms Grok Build successfully loaded/launched in the running build — live e2e confirmation beyond the c11-side plumbing checks above.
Landing PR opened: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/242 (land/pr-212 → main). Preserves contributor authorship on commit 1; modernization in commit 2.

Landed PR #212 (Grok Build) via rebased PR #242 (merged 2026-06-12). Contributor authorship preserved (commit 75c0550, Atin <atin@atin.me>); modernization in a separate follow-up commit. Added GrokStrategy to the live conversation-store resume registry (PR predated it), kept the AgentRestartRegistry fallback row for parity, 6-locale agentType.grok localization, pbxproj membership, strategy tests. Validated: full app build green, c11-logic green (incl. grok factory test), live socket round-trips on tagged build (default-agent set/get grok, set-agent --type grok stores canonical terminal_type), CI all-green (build job ran conversation strategy tests), and OPERATOR confirmed Grok Build launches live. Original #212 closed with thanks. Unblocks C11-137 (#215).
